title: H-MERGEROWNFLIP-1 part A, scenarios 1 + 3: a merged MEMBER rents a building while merged, the company saves and reloads, and the member's own buildings (the new rental and its standing shop) never enter the flip table on the member - no 'flip ON' of a key the ledger names MINE, no save-strip skip, both businesses intact on both machines, the partner's shop still flipped; no false DOUBLE TENANCY on any flipped partner shop. Ends dissolved. Also (scenario 2, cheap): the host's Rent press on the client's building is refused silently.
preconditions: Reporter fixture fx-hq1 (MERGED pair melaus + Client1; vars.keepMerger so tools/regress.py resets it with --keep-merger). Host melaus runs vars.ownerShop. The client's own shop is DISCOVERED on the host (the first key the host holds flipped = a building the ledger gives the client) and its name captured as the 'business intact' baseline. Dev build with the H-MERGEROWNFLIP-1 lever `ownflip <addr>` plus forrent / rent / autosave / hostload / acceptjoin / mergestatus. The reload follows T-WALLETDUPE: the client drops, the host loads the slot the autosave wrote, the client relaunches and joins.
oracles_absent: \[LeaseProbe\] flip ON of a key the ledger names MINE

steps.note: both worlds settle (T-OWNFLIP2 run 1: 35 s was not enough); the host's 10 s merger push has run
PREMISE: merged; the first building the host holds flipped is one the ledger gives the client
PREMISE (host): the client's shop is a flipped partner building here, tenant = the client

steps.expect_result: ^OK ownflip .* rented=True flipped=False adopted=False truly=True ledger='${clientPid}' mine=True name='[^']+'
steps.note: PREMISE (client): its own shop - rented natively, NOT flipped, the pushed ledger tenant is the client itself; the business name is the 'intact' baseline
PREMISE: the host's shop is a flipped partner building on the client
scenario 2 (also in T-OWNFLIP2): the host's Rent press on a building the ledger gives the client is refused silently before any money moves
the ledger keeps the client
the member rents natively (BuildingHelper.RentBuilding -> Patch_RentBuilding -> RentRequest to the host)
the host stamps the ledger; its 10 s merger push carries the new key + tenant to both flip sets

steps.expect_result: ^OK ownflip .* rented=True flipped=False adopted=False truly=True ledger='${clientPid}' mine=True
steps.note: the member's NEW rental: in the company list, tenant = me, never flipped here
the host shows the member's new rental as a company building (flipped)
the client's upload reaches the host and the slot manifest is stamped before the load
as T-WALLETDUPE: the member leaves, the host loads the save, the member comes back
the host's world loads
the client is served the slot's save and settles; merger pushes arrive
still merged; partner buildings flipped again

steps.expect_result: ^OK ownflip .* rented=True flipped=False adopted=False truly=True ledger='${clientPid}' mine=True
steps.note: THE ASSERTION: the rental made while merged came back as the member's OWN lease (the save did not strip it) and was not flipped

steps.expect_result: ^OK ownflip .* rented=True flipped=False .*truly=True ledger='${clientPid}' mine=True name='${cName}'
steps.note: the member's standing shop: own, not flipped, business intact
and intact on the host (a flipped partner building there)
the partner's shop is still a flipped company building on the member
and the host's own shop is its own (the flip no longer reads the flag on the host either)
